message.content: **Summary:** I reviewed the saved notes (long-term holder, prefers large-cap technology, dividends reinvested manually) and the account (100 shares of MSFT, $50,000 cash, no prior trades today), then checked AAPL's quote at $222.70 (bid $222.68 / ask $222.72, as of 2024-11-06 15:05 UTC). AAPL fits the mandate's large-cap tech preference, and the fundamentals from its FY2024 10-K (filed 2024-11-01) support a long-term entry: revenue of $391.0B, net income of $93.7B, and diluted EPS of $6.08. I placed a single buy limit order for 44 shares at $222.80 — a limit just above the ask so it would fill promptly while staying close to market — which executed at $222.80 for a total of $9,803.20. That is within the $10,000 per-order cap and well under the $20,000 daily total, it is a buy (no money moved out of the account), and the remaining cash is roughly $40,197. No MSFT order was placed.
